title: Subject Matter Expert - Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.) Eligible Locations: Language Requirement: Fluent English Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory Hourly Rate: $60.00 Minimum Hours: No minimum Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability About Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills. The Opportunity We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role;
instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic. Please note: This is a\ "bench\" model. By verifyingyour credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching. What you’ll be doing When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve: Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity. Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards. Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional\ "human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you’ll bring Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.G., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent). Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions. Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets. Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project? This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments. Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities. Links to more information on Prolific Website Youtube Privacy Statement By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description: About RegrowRegrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.About the RoleAs Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.What You’ll Do- Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.- Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.- Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.- Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.- Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.- Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.- Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.- Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.What You’ll Bring- Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.- Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.- Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.- Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.- Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.- Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.- Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.- Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.- Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.- Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.- Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.Nice to Have- Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.- Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.- Working knowledge of Spanish.Why Regrow- Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.- High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.- A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.- Competitive compensation and benefits.Acerca de RegrowRegrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.Sobre el RolComo Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.Qué Harás- Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos estratégicas.- Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.- Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.- Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.- Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para adopción y señales regulatorias.- Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.Qué Aportarás- Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.- Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.- Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.- Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.- Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.- Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.- Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.- Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.Deseable- Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.- Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.- Conocimiento funcional del español.Por Qué Regrow- Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.- Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.- Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.- Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

description:

Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil;
Manter o CRM (HubSpot)atualizado com precisão e disciplina, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline;

Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound;
Experiência com vendasconsultivas;
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores;
Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, HubSpot é diferencial;
Ensino superior completo. Também é legal se você tiver: Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia;
Familiaridade com HubSpot. Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte;

Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências de PR e assessorias de imprensa;

Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance;

title: Qa/Qc Manager – Data Centers
description: Estamos buscando profissionais de Quality Engineering (QE) com foco total em automação. Você fará parte de um time orientado à inovação, excelência técnica e qualidade ponta a ponta, atuando em um ecossistema distribuído, com integrações, mensageria e pipelines CI/CD maduros. Responsabilidades Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados com foco em APIs e microserviços. Especificar e implementar cenários em BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório). Executar smoke tests e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas. Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS). Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes e execução em pipelines. Apoiar investigação de falhas com ferramentas de observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces). Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações assegurando qualidade ponta a ponta. Requisitos Obrigatórios Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação). Experiência com BDD + Gherkin (uso obrigatório) e Xray com cenários em Gherkin. Domínio profundo de APIs (payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, tratamento de erros). Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins). Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados. Experiência em arquitetura distribuída / microserviços. Domínio de técnicas de teste caixa preta e caixa branca. Vivência com smoke testing. Programação em JavaScript (eliminatório) – capacidade real de implementar, manter e evoluir código de automação. Diferenciais Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento). Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting. Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Loki). Experiência com testes de performance e segurança. Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Noções de Terraform. A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

You will work extensively with Claude Code CLI to build, test, and iterate on agent systems directly from the terminal — writing production-grade code, managing project structures, and leveraging Claude’s coding capabilities for rapid developme

comprometimento não é só um pensamento;
e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Key Responsibilities Security: Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources. Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.G., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services. Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements. HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control. Automation and Scripting: Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure. HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance. CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.G., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build). DevOps and Monitoring: Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.G., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.G., Kubernetes). Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.G., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments. Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.G., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly. Data and Analytics: Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.G., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads. Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.G., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications. Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.G., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines. Cloud Architecture: Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions. Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.G., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications. API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.G., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs. Required Qualifications Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team. Cloud Infrastructure: Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.G., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions). Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.G., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN). Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore. Onde você vai trabalhar? Regime 100% Home Office. Tempo de Projeto: Tempo indeterminado. Contratação CLT + Benefícios Equipe internacional.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues. Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). recommend scalable architectures, and align technical solutions with long-term business goals.- Lead deep technical discovery sessions to understand customer data maturity, use cases, and operational constraints.- Own the technical customer relationship as a trusted advisor, guiding solution design across cloud-native, embedded, and secure analytics environments.- Design, review, and optimize data models, queries, and analytical workflows to support performant, scalable solutions.- Deliver onboarding sessions, solution walkthroughs, and enablement workshops tailored to customers with intermediate to advanced data and analytics maturity.- Create and deliver customized technical presentations and demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.- Provide guidance on authentication, security, and access control concepts, including SSO patterns and user-level data access strategies.- Consult on embedding analytics into applications, including session handling and integration best practices.- Support solution reviews, migrations, upgrades, and architectural optimizations across customer environments.- Assist customers with platform administration and configuration tasks, including API automation and environment setup.- Collaborate closely with internal engineering, product, and support teams to surface customer feedback, identify issues, and influence future enhancements.- Capture and share best practices, reference architectures, and technical assets to scale knowledge across customers and internal teams.- Evangelize Sisense best practices through workshops, community engagement, and technical thought leadership.About You- 3-5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.G., Solution Consultant, Pre-Sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or similar).- Hands-on experience with modern BI and analytics platforms (Sisense preferred;
Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, or similar acceptable).- Proven success leading or contributing to complex BI, cloud, or data platform implementations, from discovery through delivery.- Strong data modeling expertise within a BI context, including dimensional modeling and working with large, complex datasets.- SQL proficiency: understands join types, normalization - has the ability to join data across disparate sources, optimize queries, and design efficient analytical models.- Experience designing and delivering customized technical presentations and product demonstrations for audiences ranging from hands-on practitioners to executive stakeholders.- Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, adapting communication style to technical and non-technical audiences alike.- Solid technical foundation, including experience with:- JavaScript, HTML/CSS (nice to have;
strong preference for hands-on exposure)- REST APIs and platform integrations- Linux-based environments and containerized architectures (Docker, Kubernetes)- Experience providing guidance on authentication and security, including implementing or supporting SSO solutions (SAML 2.0, OIDC, JWT).- Detailed understanding of analytics embedding, including hands-on implementation using iFrames and related integration patterns.- Working knowledge of ETL methodologies, data pipelines, and upstream data preparation concepts.- Nice to have: prior experience with technical project management or leading workstreams across cross-functional teams.What We Offer- Employment through a partner agency (B2B).- Competitive base salary up to USD 4300 per month (depending on experience).- Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.- Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.- Professional development and growth opportunities.

title: Ai Reasoning Engineer (Mathematics & Python)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Description We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions. Offer Details: Pay: $1500 per month (Net/take-home) Mode of work - Fully Remote Responsibilities: Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies Required Qualifications: 5+ years in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science — competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research background Python programming — NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy) Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations. Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers — not subjective or open-ended. Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues. Understanding of numerical methods — floating point tolerance, convergence criteria, error bounds. Strong plus: Experience creating math competition problems (AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar). Research in mathematics, theoretical CS, or quantitative fields. Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification. Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing Example of what you will produce: A task requiring analysis of a system of 50 coupled differential equations modeling a chemical reaction network. The agent must determine equilibrium concentrations, stability conditions, and bifurcation points. Input includes the reaction network as a matrix, rate constants, and initial conditions. The verifier checks numerical answers with tolerance (1e-6), validates eigenvalue analysis for stability, and confirms bifurcation parameter ranges. The decomposition splits into 4 sub-agents: one computes equilibria, one analyzes local stability, one maps bifurcations, and one synthesizes the phase portrait. Oracle scores 1.0, single-agent scores 0.25, multi-agent scores 0.80. Offer Details: Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST. Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave). Duration of Contract: 6months (expected start date is next week). How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID 75046 in the email subject line.

title: Ai Reasoning Engineer (Mathematics & Python)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Description We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions. Offer Details: Pay: $1500 per month (Net/take-home) Mode of work - Fully Remote Responsibilities: Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies Required Qualifications: 5+ years in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science — competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research background Python programming — NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy) Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations. Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers — not subjective or open-ended. Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues. Understanding of numerical methods — floating point tolerance, convergence criteria, error bounds. Strong plus: Experience creating math competition problems (AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar). Research in mathematics, theoretical CS, or quantitative fields. Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification. Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing Example of what you will produce: A task requiring analysis of a system of 50 coupled differential equations modeling a chemical reaction network. The agent must determine equilibrium concentrations, stability conditions, and bifurcation points. Input includes the reaction network as a matrix, rate constants, and initial conditions. The verifier checks numerical answers with tolerance (1e-6), validates eigenvalue analysis for stability, and confirms bifurcation parameter ranges. The decomposition splits into 4 sub-agents: one computes equilibria, one analyzes local stability, one maps bifurcations, and one synthesizes the phase portrait. Oracle scores 1.0, single-agent scores 0.25, multi-agent scores 0.80. Offer Details: Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST. Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave). Duration of Contract: 6months (expected start date is next week). How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID 75046 in the email subject line.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.G., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs. Required Qualifications Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team. Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.G., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN). Profundo conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados (Power BI). Experiência na definição e implementação de estratégias analíticas. Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem dimensional. Experiência em levantamento e entendimento de requisitos de negócio. Vivência com consumo e manipulação de dados em ambientes de Big Data. Experiência com Data Warehouses (ex: Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse ou similares). Experiência com Data Lakes / Lakehouses (ex: Amazon S3, Athena, Glue, Azure Data Lake, Databricks ou similares). Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou similares), de acordo com o contexto do projeto. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de traduzir dados em insights e influenciar decisões estratégicas. Escopo de atuação: Realizar e validar requisitos de negócio. Realizar e validar a modelagem dimensional (conceitual, lógica e fisica). Executar projetos analíticos, desde a concepção até a entrega. Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de análise de dados. Colaborar com líderes de negócios para identificar oportunidades de análise. Apresentar insights e recomendações para stakeholders.

title: Ai Reasoning Engineer (Mathematics & Python)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Description We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions. Offer Details: Pay: $1500 per month (Net/take-home) Mode of work - Fully Remote Responsibilities: Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies Required Qualifications: 5+ years in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science — competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research background Python programming — NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy) Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations. Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers — not subjective or open-ended. Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues. Understanding of numerical methods — floating point tolerance, convergence criteria, error bounds. Strong plus: Experience creating math competition problems (AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar). Research in mathematics, theoretical CS, or quantitative fields. Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification. Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing Example of what you will produce: A task requiring analysis of a system of 50 coupled differential equations modeling a chemical reaction network. The agent must determine equilibrium concentrations, stability conditions, and bifurcation points. Input includes the reaction network as a matrix, rate constants, and initial conditions. The verifier checks numerical answers with tolerance (1e-6), validates eigenvalue analysis for stability, and confirms bifurcation parameter ranges. The decomposition splits into 4 sub-agents: one computes equilibria, one analyzes local stability, one maps bifurcations, and one synthesizes the phase portrait. Oracle scores 1.0, single-agent scores 0.25, multi-agent scores 0.80. Offer Details: Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST. Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave). Duration of Contract: 6months (expected start date is next week). How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID 75046 in the email subject line.

CNH ativa e veículo próprio (imprescindível para atuação na região). Disponibilidade para deslocamento frequente.

Zelar pela correta utilização do uniforme e EPIs, asseio pessoal, materiais e produtos, conforme padronização, higienização e sob orientação do superior hierárquico e normas de segurança, conforme orientação da empresa;
Organizar o DML (depósito de material limpo) e o material de limpeza, carinho funcional e/ou balaio, de acordo com a padronização estabelecida;
Entregar o material (carrinho funcional e balaio) e DML, organizados, conforme protocolo estabelecido no POP (procedimento operacional padrão) para o próximo colaborador pessoa que assumirá o plantão, visando à continuidade da qualidade do serviço prestado;
Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados.
Seguir os cronogramas preestabelecido, diário, semanal e mensal;
Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

title: Sap Consultant
description: About the Role The SAP MDG (Material Master Data) Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP MDG function for all types of master data, and its integration with S/4HANA and other applications across global enterprises. The role ensures data governance, master data quality, workflow enforcement and compliance with business rules. This key role focuses on providing technology solutions for business requirements, providing global design and localization as warranted, stabilizing and enhancing the existing solutions, resolving defects, production break-fixes, as well as providing recommendation regarding optimal business processes by leveraging SAP best practices. This person will collaborate with the Product Owner, Project managers, system architects and the business partners to understand key objectives and challenges, ensure successful outcomes, and provide the right direction in the dynamic business environment. Responsibilities Serve as the subject matter expert for solution development in the SAP MDG area Design, configure, and implement SAP MDG solutions for domains such as Business Partner, Customer, Vendor, Material, and Finance. Lead end-to-end MDG implementations, including requirements gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, and go-live support Configure MDG data models, change request types, workflows, business rules, validations, and derivations Integrate SAP MDG with ECC, S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems Collaborate with business stakeholders to define data governance processes, roles, and policies Support data migration, data cleansing, and data quality initiatives Configure and support BRF+, Workflow (WS-BPEL/Flexible Workflow), DRF, and UI (Fiori/Web Dynpro) Perform configuration of systems and manage transport as part of ITSM, Cloud ALM, and change management across the SAP landscape Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous improvement enhancements Create functional and technical documentation, including design specs, test scripts, and user guides Support user training and knowledge transfer activities to the managed service team. Ensure compliance with data standards, audit requirements, and best practices Perform Functional Unit testing, Product testing, System integration testing, cross functional testing, testing of SAP upgrades, Performance testing, etc. Support UAT, provide user training and support change management and business enablement. Manage and maintain overall solution architecture, scalability, and integrity. Provides hands-on support to developers (e.G., resolving technical blockers and reviewing code) Other job duties and projects as assigned. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data Governance Required Skills Strong hands-on experience with SAP MDG-BP, MDG-M, MDG-F, or MDG-S. Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration and other SAAS and non-SAP systems. Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and master data lifecycle Experience configuring: Data Models & Change Request Types, BRF+ Rules, Workflow, Data Replication Framework (DRF) Knowledge of Fiori apps and MDG UI customization Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, IT, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of MDG solutions. Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members and end-users on MDG best practices and solutions. Provide regular reports on system health and performance. Knowledge of agile methodologies and frameworks such as Kanban as well as use of tools like Jira and Service Now. Facilitate work and resource estimation, track progress, provide escalations and status updates. Preferred Skills SAP MDG Certification
